generationMethod: Manual authoring from the actual implementation at branch feature/marea-mc17-premium-design-system: core/types.ts, components/*, theme/marea-theme.ts, docs/marea/design-system/data/{layout-tokens,color-roles,typography-roles}.json, scripts/check-marea-design-system.mjs and e2e/design-system/*.spec.ts. No automated audit generated this dataset.
scope: Applicable WCAG 2.2 Level AA criteria for the isolated MC-17 design system and its internal catalogue, with the component/test evidence that exists and the evidence that does not.
conformanceStatement: No WCAG conformance claim is made for the design system, the internal catalogue or the public website. Automated axe rules and component assertions are partial evidence only; no independent accessibility audit has been completed.
targetLevel: WCAG 2.2 AA (design target, not a certified conformance level)

qualityTarget.reason: The implementation targets a 3px solid focus ring with offset/inset tokens as an internal quality target; AAA focus appearance is not measured or claimed.

knownLimitations: No independent accessibility audit and no assistive-technology testing (screen reader, voice control, switch access) has been performed.

Automated coverage is axe-core with wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa and wcag22aa tags in Chromium only. The recorded summary reports 0 violations in web-light, instrument-day and instrument-sunlight, and 0 color-contrast violations after the correction inside the preview-only component documentation block.
Contrast ratios are computed from declared token values; anti-aliasing, glare, night adaptation and display hardware are not modelled.
Instrument day/sunlight/night modes are software-only specimens; no marine hardware visibility or night-vision performance is validated.
The internal catalogue is not a public page and has no main landmark; axe region rules are disabled there, which is a documented deviation from a public-page audit.
Catalogue screenshots and axe runs are Chromium/Windows-specific; other engines and platforms are not covered.
1.4.12 Text Spacing has no dedicated override test at authoring time.
No full-conformance claim is authorised by this dataset or by the validator.

criteria.name: Info and Relationships
criteria.why: Family, edition, bundle and readiness surfaces encode relationships through headings, lists, definition lists, tables and labelled regions; an incorrect structure would misrepresent the product hierarchy.
criteria.howTested: Semantic elements in MareaSectionHeading, MareaSpecTable, MareaDefinitionList, MareaDataQuality and MareaReadinessPanel; axe tags wcag2a in e2e/design-system/accessibility.spec.ts; manual heading-order review remains pending.

criteria.name: Use of Color
criteria.why: Status tones (critical, warning, safe, stale, info, neutral) could otherwise be the only carrier of meaning in badges, notices and readiness rows.
criteria.howTested: Status badge requires a text label plus a shape icon (MC17-18); the Playwright test asserts every marea-status-badge has non-empty visible text and is not hidden; catalogue renders explanation paragraphs next to every derived state.

criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.why: Normal and large text must reach 4.5:1 and 3:1 respectively on every declared mode and surface before any public use.
criteria.howTested: scripts/check-marea-design-system.mjs computes WCAG relative luminance over declared token pairs for all four modes and writes data/contrast-evidence.json. The recorded file is status PASS with 296 pair/mode measurements and 0 failures.

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.why: The catalogue and components use fluid type and must remain usable when text is enlarged to 200%.
criteria.howTested: e2e/design-system/responsive.spec.ts applies html { font-size: 200% } at six widths and asserts no horizontal page overflow, no clipped controls and no overlapping sibling controls.

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.why: Content must not require two-dimensional scrolling at 320 CSS px width and at 200% zoom; dense specification tables are the main risk.
criteria.howTested: e2e/design-system/responsive.spec.ts checks widths 320, 360, 390, 768, 1024 and 1440, asserts documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth + 1, and requires every table to sit in a labelled, focusable, horizontally scrollable region.

criteria.name: Non-text Contrast
criteria.why: Control boundaries, focus indicators and status shapes must reach 3:1 against adjacent colours; the design system exposes borderStrong, focusRing and status tokens for this purpose.
criteria.howTested: Token contrast pairs of kind ui are computed by the validator; the recorded contrast evidence is PASS with 0 failures. MareaButton and MareaFormField use border-strong and focus tokens; a 3:1 internal floor is declared for the disabled text token even though WCAG exempts disabled controls.

criteria.name: Text Spacing
criteria.why: Component text must remain usable when a user overrides line height, paragraph spacing, letter spacing or word spacing.
criteria.howTested: No dedicated text-spacing override test exists at authoring time; the 200% font-size test is not a substitute. This is recorded as an unimplemented check.

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.why: Tabs, accordions, disclosures, the responsive navigation, buttons and links must be fully operable without a pointer, with no keyboard trap.
criteria.howTested: e2e/design-system/keyboard.spec.ts exercises real Tab/Enter/Space/Escape/Arrow/Home/End events for tabs, accordion, disclosure, responsive navigation and a disabled button, and runs a 40-press trap check. Disabled MareaButton remains reachable via aria-disabled and blocks activation.

criteria.name: Pause, Stop, Hide
criteria.why: The system must not auto-update, blink or move content without a user control; alert motion is capped and reduced-motion is honoured.
criteria.howTested: No auto-rotating or auto-updating surface exists in the catalogue; motion tokens cap state transitions at 120-200ms and disable transitions under prefers-reduced-motion; alert pulse is capped at 1 Hz by token. Manual review of future consumers remains required.

criteria.name: Three Flashes or Below Threshold
criteria.why: No component may flash more than three times per second, particularly alarm and status surfaces.
criteria.howTested: No flashing animation is implemented; the optional alert pulse token is capped at 1 Hz; no automated flash test exists. Manual review of animated content remains required.

criteria.name: Focus Order
criteria.why: Sequential focus must follow a meaningful order in the catalogue and in composed surfaces.
criteria.howTested: e2e/design-system/keyboard.spec.ts presses Tab 40 times and asserts no consecutive repeat and more than ten distinct focus targets; tabs use a roving tab index; navigation returns focus to its toggle after Escape.

criteria.name: Focus Visible
criteria.why: Every keyboard-operable control must show a visible focus indicator.
criteria.howTested: Components declare :focus-visible with focus tokens (MC17-15); e2e/design-system/accessibility.spec.ts reaches the first button and first link by Tab and asserts an outline or box-shadow ring in web-light and instrument-night.

criteria.name: Focus Not Obscured (Minimum)
criteria.why: A focused control must not be entirely hidden by sticky or overlay content.
criteria.howTested: The focus test asserts indicator presence but does not yet measure obstruction by sticky headers or overlays; the responsive navigation is non-overlay by design. Gap recorded.

criteria.name: Target Size (Minimum)
criteria.why: Pointer targets must be at least 24 by 24 CSS px or have equivalent spacing.
criteria.howTested: Layout tokens declare --marea-touch-target-min: 24px and MareaButton uses it as min-inline-size with a 32-48px block size. No dedicated Playwright target-size assertion exists at authoring time.

criteria.name: Error Identification
criteria.why: Form errors must be described in text and programmatically associated with the field.
criteria.howTested: MareaFormField renders the error paragraph with role=alert and exposes describedBy() so the consumer can bind aria-describedby; the field never relies on a red border alone. No automated form-error test exists.

criteria.name: Error Suggestion
criteria.why: When an input error is detected, a correction suggestion must be provided in text.
criteria.howTested: The component provides the error slot; the suggestion text is supplied by the consumer. No validation logic or suggestion catalogue exists in the design system, so this is a consumer obligation.

criteria.name: Name, Role, Value
criteria.why: Custom compositions must expose correct accessible names, roles and states, especially tabs, accordions, navigation toggles and status badges.
criteria.howTested: Native elements are preferred (button, details/summary, nav, table); ARIA is limited to aria-current, aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-selected, aria-labelledby and aria-describedby; axe tags wcag2a/wcag2aa/wcag21a/wcag21aa/wcag22aa run on all four modes.

automatedAudit.scope: internal catalogue, four visual modes, default ES locale, Chromium

publicSiteEvidence.scope: existing public pages with axe tags, serious/critical violations only
publicSiteEvidence.relation: covers the untouched public site, not the MC-17 design system

enforcement.check38Expectation: required criteria 1.3.1, 1.4.1, 1.4.3, 1.4.11, 2.1.1, 2.4.7, 2.4.11, 2.5.8, 3.3.1 and 4.1.2 present; no full-conformance claim recorded
